style: Dark sports-editorial poster energy: near-black #070707 ground, film grain over everything, compressed huge all-caps Anton type in paper #f4f1e8, thin accent rules, Space Mono eyebrow labels. Restrained accent color — lime #a3e635 owns scenes 1-4, the $2,000 slam flips dominance to orange #f97316 (+ yellow #facc15 heat on the number only): that single accent flip IS the pattern-interrupt at the emotional peak. Hard cuts between scenes, no crossfades. Mascot art (gritty anime pepper athlete) sits BEHIND type — dimmed ~60-75%, grain-matched, never competing with the headline. Brand-authored, zero emoji, no exclamation stacks.

blocks.caption-kinetic-slam: primary block for scenes 1, 2, 4 — swap words per scene, emphasis_words -> word--emphasis, palette ink/paper/lime, font Anton, retime to the scene windows below
blocks.apple-money-count: scene 5 only — strip the finance styling to brand: target 2000, prefix '$', no suffix; keep the counter+burst mechanics but recolor burst to orange/yellow on ink, Anton tabular-nums; count-up is a fast 0.45s odometer ripple AFTER the slam lands (slam first, digits settle second)
blocks.grain-overlay: full-duration film grain on top of everything, subtle
blocks.logo-reveal equivalent: scene 6 is hand-composed type lockup (no logo asset exists) — do NOT pull logo-outro; simple stacked type + thin rule + glow on the sonic-logo hit

fonts.note: Anton is the headline voice everywhere; Bebas Neue for sub-lines/date; Space Mono for eyebrow labels and the @handle. All display type uppercase.

customize.palette_discipline: lime + orange dominant, never at equal weight in the same scene. Scenes 1-4: lime accents only. Scene 5: orange/yellow only. Scene 6: paper type, one lime rule, orange only in the glow of the brand lockup.
customize.mascot_treatment: 1024x1536 transparent PNGs, place at 80-95% canvas height, anchored low, z-index below type, opacity 0.25-0.75 per scene spec, slight slow drift (hold_breath scale 1.0->1.03) so they never sit dead static; grain overlay unifies them with the ground.
customize.safety_rule: $2,000 must NEVER be on screen without 'FIRST PLACE AT A FULL 28-TEAM FIELD' visible or arriving within the same scene — the support line enters at 6.6 and holds to the scene cut at 8.2 (1.6s legible, >= 0.5s requirement met). Do not shorten it below 0.5s under any retime.

scenes.motion: slam — the full line drops from y:-300 power4.out and LANDS at 0.12 (serve-snap fires at 0.0, visual anticipated for perceived sync) + shake on land + one-frame paper #f4f1e8 flash at impact; emphasis words carry lime color_shift; micro hold_breath 0.5-1.2; type fills ~85% width, stacked 3 lines, compressed leading

word_reveal — per-word slide_bottom stagger 0.09 from 1.3; underline_sweep (lime, thin rule) draws left-to-right under CLOSES at 2.0; menace-walk mascot looms behind at 25% opacity, slow drift up-left (the season closing in); no exit — hard cut

scale_punch on POBLANO OPEN at 2.9 (back.out(2.2)), Anton, biggest type of the piece so far; Space Mono eyebrow '08·01·26 · AURORA, IL' typewriters in above the title from 3.1; Bebas Neue sub-line 'AUG 1' slide_bottom at 3.3 below a thin lime rule (bar_wipe); jump-serve mascot sweeps in from right at 3.0 (slide_right entrance, 70% opacity, 90% height) with slight parallax drift behind the type

bracket-lock moment — two thin lime rules bar_wipe in from left and right edges and SNAP framing the number as bracket-lock.wav fires at 4.4; '28 TEAMS' scale_punch at 4.5, '28' oversized (2x TEAMS) in lime; Bebas sub-line 'THE BIGGEST FIELD THE SERIES HAS SEEN' slide_bottom at 4.8, holds to cut; block mascot (the wall) rises slide_bottom behind at 4.5, 60% opacity; energy-rise starts 5.08 and the whole scene hold_breath-compresses (scale 1.0->1.04, subtle shake ramp) through 6.0 — tension INTO the money slam

support_text.sub_bebas: THE BIGGEST FIELD THE SERIES HAS SEEN

stat.label: FIRST PLACE AT A FULL 28-TEAM FIELD

scenes.motion: THE PEAK + the pattern-interrupt: accent flips lime->orange. impact-slam audio fires 5.95, '$2,000' slams at 6.0 (y:-300 power4.out) with hard shake + orange #f97316 flash frame; digits do a 0.45s odometer settle (apple-money-count mechanics, tabular-nums, yellow #facc15 heat on the number, seek-safe proxy tween) landing by 6.5; scale_pulse + glow on the beat at 6.6; champion mascot (finger-#1 raised — pairs with first place) scale_punch in at 6.15 behind-right at 75% opacity; support line 'FIRST PLACE AT A FULL 28-TEAM FIELD' slide_bottom in Bebas at 6.6 under a thin orange rule and HOLDS to 8.2 — 1.6s legible, this is the payout condition and is non-negotiable; scale_out exit on the whole group at 8.1

hard cut to clean type-only lockup on ink (no mascot — the brand closes alone): sizzle-tail rides the cut at 8.15; 'REGISTER AT LETSPEPPER.COM' slide_bottom in Bebas at 8.3; thin lime rule bar_wipe at 8.5; '@letspepper.open' fade_in in Space Mono at 8.7; 'LET'S PEPPER' scale_grow in Anton (largest element) at 8.9; sonic-logo fires 9.9 -> glow pulse (soft orange textShadow, yoyo) on the LET'S PEPPER lockup at 9.95, then hold_breath to 11.0 — everything readable a full 2s, no exit, end on the held lockup as the sonic tail rings out at 10.98

audio.syncs: hook slam of ONE EVENT LEFT lands 0.12
lime bracket rules snap around 28 TEAMS at 4.5
riser crests exactly at 6.0 — runs under the s4 tension compress, hands off to the slam
$2,000 lands at 6.0 (cue anticipated 0.05s for perceived sync)
hard cut into the CTA scene
LET'S PEPPER lockup glow at 9.95; tail ends 10.98, piece ends 11.0 — sonic-logo closes the piece
